title: Great compact iron for many uses!
text: Great compact iron for many uses!. Very nice compact iron and with the name Proctor Silex you know you are getting a quality item. It's been years (seriously) since I had used an iron and when I saw this I wanted to try it.This little iron packs a punch and steams and dewrinkles everything. I have been using this weekly on shirts to get them crisp looking and is also small enough to take on a trip to help with wrinkled packed clothes. This is a staple in my house now and I am not sure what I have done without it before.

product_metadata.title: Proctor Silex Iron & Vertical Steamer for Clothes with DuraGlide Ceramic Nonstick Soleplate, 1200 Watts, Adjustable Steam Settings, White (17011)
features: DURAGLIDE CERAMIC NONSTICK SOLEPLATE. This steam iron’s soleplate is 7 times more durable than traditional non-stick.
ADJUSTABLE STEAM. With spray and blast control, you can remove the toughest wrinkles on thick fabrics.
DOUBLES AS A VERTICAL STEAMER. The steam function lets you steam wrinkles from clothes while they’re still on the hanger.

PEACE OF MIND WITH 3-WAY AUTO SHUTOFF: Have peace of mind knowing the clothing iron will automatically power off after 30 seconds when placed on its soleplate or side and after 15 minutes when propped upright on its heel.
TESTED, PROVEN. 100% performance tested for durability and reliability to ensure excellent quality when it arrives to your home. Condensation may be visible in the steam chamber from this test.
description: The Proctor Silex DuraGlide Steam Iron eliminates wrinkles quickly thanks to powerful steam options and a non-stick ceramic soleplate, which is 7x more durable than traditional non-stick. Adjustable steam with spray and blast lets you remove the toughest of wrinkles.
